limits.sandbox: CPU-only Docker python@c61cffc3, no network, 256 MB, 1 CPU, 10 s per grade

scheduling.placement: agent j of case c on replica/grader host (c+j)%4
scheduling.concurrency_note: each arm alone on the fleet: 20 client requests per node <= 25

serving.launch: Inkling-2-Mini-1x-DGX-Spark v2.9.2 (a29380b; scripts/launch.sh sha 9428eb69...) `scripts/launch.sh up` with release defaults (SPEC=dflash2, drafter incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2@4f9088ea, MEM_FRACTION 0.88, CTX 262144, memguard 3.5 GiB) and only the swarm wiring env NAME=swarm-recipe PORT=30000 HOST=127.0.0.1 SERVED=inkling; the swarm serving default since 2026-11-25 (coding-v29-r2-v1: -20 % wall, -20 % Wh at equal quality)

selection: the first proposal in TIME order that passes ALL feedback cases ends the case: other agents of the case are terminated, queued ones never start; solved if it passes ALL holdout cases
resume_rule: As in earlier coding plans: on an operational fault the runner stops admissions; the same arm is continued only for unfinished cases with the same seeds and documented as an amendment.
frozen_note: Frozen before any call with fresh seeds 70-78 (coding-hard-v1 used <= 66) and offset 70700 (unused); the arms differ only in study, ab_arm, runner, differential_gate, execution.
question: Does a live differential-consensus gate on top of the public-test gate cut wrong coding answers at an acceptable cost in solved cases and energy?
execution: python inkling/diffgate_arms.py --plan CODING_DIFFGATE_CONTROL_PLAN.json --output runs/coding-diffgate-v1-control (alone on the fleet; arm order control, gate)

decision_rule.pass: PASS iff wrong(gate) <= 0.6 x wrong(control) AND solved(gate) >= solved(control) - 3 AND GPU Wh per solved case(gate) <= 1.5 x control (unrounded; energy covering all four nodes)
decision_rule.wrong: an answered case whose answer fails the hidden holdout tests
decision_rule.reported: solved, wrong, unanswered, agents started, generator tokens, sandbox seconds, wall, server generated tokens, Wh per solved, fallback cases, and SHARED-BUG cases separately (gate arm: every distinct passer agreed and the accepted answer is still wrong: the known blind spot)
decision_rule.incomplete: INCOMPLETE (no decision) unless both arms are complete: each run embeds its plan, the plans differ only in arm fields, no runner errors, cases exactly the frozen 216 task x seed keys, runner exit 0, drain confirmed, no signal, energy covering all four nodes

exclusions: None; all 72 cases of each arm count.
disclosure: code_elastic has a 25 % higher per-agent cap (40,960 vs 32,768 tokens); every extra token is charged.
cases: coding-hard-v1 evaluation split, 24 tasks x fresh seeds 70-78 = 216 cases per arm (no earlier plan or run used seeds >= 67 on this corpus); agent_seed_offset 70700 (unused); both arms the same cases and offset
